A public research university (38,000 students): Education institutions feel technology failures at enrolment and results time, when volume spikes and patience does not. The Achala program started with the peak load —. The baseline signed in week two made the cost visible in units the finance team already owns, and the engagement ran under the standard Achala charter — a named metric, a named control owner and gates that evidence every move.
At-risk students surfaced at failure; LMS/SIS/support data siloed.
Advisors overloaded with administrative casework. GenAI governance vacuum; integrity disputes rising.

The student-success platform unified SIS/LMS/support data with outcome lineage; early-warning models feed advising orchestration (Swarm) with case management; and the integrity infrastructure deployed policy rails plus logged assistive AI per course under faculty-governance sign-off.

blocks.x: The three things that made it hold

items: one governed definition per metric ended the metric disputes before the build scaled.
the agents ran inside a defined policy limit with replay, so autonomy never outran the evidence.
the models and retrieval systems were evaluated before anyone trusted them, grounded answers, cited sources, measured quality.
